title: Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Help
description: A nine-day prayer to Our Lady of Perpetual Help, seeking her constant assistance and maternal protection in all the circumstances of daily life. This devotion emphasizes Mary's immediate and ongoing help for her children.
intention: For daily assistance in all needs, protection from dangers, help in difficulties, strength in temptations, and Mary's constant maternal care
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days when you need Our Lady's help with ongoing challenges or daily struggles. This devotion emphasizes that Mary's help is not just for extraordinary moments but for the ordinary difficulties we face each day. Our Lady of Perpetual Help is particularly invoked by those who need consistent support and guidance in their daily lives.
background_info: The devotion to Our Lady of Perpetual Help centers on a miraculous icon that originated in Crete and was brought to Rome in the 15th century. The icon shows Mary holding the Child Jesus, with the Archangels Michael and Gabriel displaying the instruments of Christ's passion. The title 'Perpetual Help' emphasizes that Mary's assistance is constant and ongoing. The Redemptorists have been custodians of this devotion since 1866, spreading it worldwide. The icon is renowned for countless miracles and is especially popular among Eastern Christians and those facing persistent difficulties.

days.title: Day 1: Mary's Constant Presence
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, I come to you today knowing that you are always present, always ready to help your children in their needs. Unlike earthly helpers who may be busy, distant, or unavailable when we need them most, you are perpetually present to assist us. Your title reminds us that your help is not occasional but constant, not temporary but lasting. I often feel alone in my struggles and forget that you are always near, ready to intercede for me with your Son. Help me to remember that I never face any difficulty by myself - you are always there, watching over me with maternal love and concern. When problems seem overwhelming or when I feel like no one understands my situation, remind me of your constant presence. Teach me to turn to you immediately when troubles arise, rather than trying to handle everything on my own. Help me to develop the habit of calling on you throughout the day, in small matters as well as large ones. Your perpetual help means that no request is too small, no problem too insignificant for your loving attention. O Mother of Perpetual Help, be with me always. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help reminds us that Mary's assistance is not limited to crisis moments but extends to every aspect of our daily lives. Her perpetual presence means we are never truly alone in our struggles.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, help me to remember that you are always present and ready to assist me in all my needs, both great and small.
days.scripture: "And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20

days.title: Day 2: Help in Daily Struggles
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, you understand that life is filled with daily struggles that can wear down our spirits and exhaust our strength. The demands of work, family responsibilities, financial pressures, health concerns, and relationship difficulties can feel overwhelming when we face them day after day. I bring to you all my daily struggles [mention specific ongoing difficulties]. You know how these persistent challenges affect not just my external circumstances but also my peace of mind and spiritual well-being. Help me to see these daily difficulties not as burdens to bear alone but as opportunities to rely more completely on your assistance. When I wake up dreading another difficult day, fill me with confidence that your help will sustain me. When I feel frustrated by problems that don't seem to have solutions, remind me that you specialize in helping with impossible situations. Give me patience when progress is slow, strength when I feel weak, and hope when circumstances seem unchanging. Help me to offer each day's struggles to your Son, uniting my small sufferings with His great sacrifice. O Mother of Perpetual Help, be my strength in daily struggles. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help understands that some of our greatest challenges are not dramatic crises but the persistent, daily difficulties that test our patience and faith. Her help is especially powerful for these ongoing struggles.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, assist me in all my daily struggles. Give me strength and patience to handle persistent difficulties with grace.
days.scripture: "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28

days.title: Day 3: Protection from Dangers
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, you who hold the Child Jesus so protectively in the sacred icon, I ask for your protection from all dangers that threaten me and my loved ones. In our world today, dangers can come in many forms - physical threats to our safety, spiritual temptations that endanger our souls, emotional attacks on our peace and well-being, and moral pressures that would lead us away from God's path. Watch over us as we travel, keeping us safe from accidents and harm. Protect our homes from break-ins, fires, and natural disasters. Shield our children from those who would hurt their innocence or lead them astray. Guard our marriages and families from the forces that would divide and destroy them. Defend us from spiritual dangers - from temptations that are too strong for us to resist alone, from false teachings that would confuse our faith, from despair that would make us lose hope in God's love. Help us to recognize dangers before they become serious threats, and give us the wisdom to avoid unnecessary risks while trusting in God's providence. When we must face unavoidable dangers, be our shield and fortress. O Mother of Perpetual Help, protect us from all harm. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: The icon of Our Lady of Perpetual Help shows Mary holding Jesus protectively, while angels display the instruments of His passion. This image reminds us that Mary's protection encompasses both temporal and eternal dangers.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, be my protection from all dangers, physical and spiritual. Keep me and my loved ones safe under your maternal care.
days.scripture: "He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge." - Psalm 91:4

days.title: Day 4: Strength in Temptation
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Sun, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, you who never sinned and never experienced the pull of temptation, yet you understand our human weakness and the struggles we face against sin. When temptation comes - whether sudden and strong or gradual and persistent - I need your help to remain faithful to your Son. Help me when I am tempted to anger, especially with those closest to me who can hurt me most deeply. Strengthen me when I am tempted to be dishonest, to take what doesn't belong to me, or to break my commitments. Protect me from the temptations of pride that make me think I'm better than others, and from the temptations of despair that make me think I'm worthless. Guard me against the allure of material things that promise happiness but cannot satisfy the deepest longings of my heart. When I am tempted to impurity, remind me that my body is a temple of the Holy Spirit. When I am tempted to neglect my relationship with God, draw me back to prayer and the sacraments. Help me to flee from occasions of sin and to choose companions and activities that support my spiritual growth. Give me the grace to see temptation as an opportunity to prove my love for God by choosing what is right. O Mother of Perpetual Help, be my strength against temptation. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help, though sinless herself, intercedes powerfully for us in our struggles against temptation. Her prayers can obtain for us the grace to overcome even our strongest temptations and to grow in virtue.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, give me strength to resist temptation and to choose what is right and good in all circumstances.
days.scripture: "No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear." - 1 Corinthians 10:13

days.title: Day 5: Help in Making Decisions
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, throughout your life you faced important decisions that required faith, courage, and trust in God's plan. When the angel Gabriel announced God's plan to you, you made the momentous decision to say 'yes' to becoming the Mother of God. When you had to decide how to respond to Jesus' public ministry, you chose to support Him even when others doubted. Help me to make wise decisions in my own life, especially when I face important choices about [mention specific decisions you're facing]. Sometimes I feel paralyzed by indecision, worried that I might make the wrong choice. Other times I rush into decisions without enough thought or prayer. Teach me to find the proper balance between careful consideration and trusting action. Help me to seek God's will through prayer, Scripture, wise counsel, and the guidance of the Church. Give me the courage to make difficult decisions when necessary, even when they require sacrifice or when others might not understand. When I make mistakes in my choices, help me to learn from them and to trust in God's ability to bring good from even my poor decisions. Guide me especially in decisions about my vocation, my relationships, my work, and my spiritual life. O Mother of Perpetual Help, help me choose wisely. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help made the greatest decision in human history when she agreed to become the Mother of God. Her example teaches us to make decisions based on faith and trust in God's providence rather than on fear or selfish desire.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, guide me in making wise decisions that honor God and lead to true happiness.
days.scripture: "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight." - Proverbs 3:5-6

days.title: Day 6: Comfort in Sorrow
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, you who are called the Mother of Sorrows because of the deep grief you experienced watching your Son suffer and die, you understand the pain of human sorrow in a way that brings true comfort to those who mourn. I come to you today carrying sorrows that weigh heavily on my heart [mention specific sorrows or losses]. Some of these sorrows come from losses I have experienced - the death of loved ones, the end of important relationships, the loss of health, dreams that didn't come true. Others come from disappointments, failures, or situations that didn't turn out as I hoped. Help me to see that sorrow, while painful, can also be redemptive when united with your sorrows and those of your Son. Teach me that grief is not a sign of weak faith but a natural response to loss that even Jesus experienced. When sorrow threatens to overwhelm me or make me bitter, remind me of your example of faithful endurance through pain. Help me to find meaning in my suffering and to trust that God can bring good from even my deepest losses. Comfort me with the hope of eternal life where there will be no more sorrow, pain, or separation. Until that day, be my source of consolation and strength. O Mother of Perpetual Help, comfort me in my sorrow. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help's experience of sorrow, particularly at the foot of the cross, qualifies her to be a source of comfort to all who suffer. Her maternal heart understands our pain and can provide the consolation we need.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, comfort me in my sorrows and help me to find hope and meaning even in painful experiences.
days.scripture: "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted." - Matthew 5:4

days.title: Day 7: Help for Family Needs
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, as a member of the Holy Family, you understand the joys and challenges of family life. You know what it means to worry about family members, to work together to meet daily needs, and to support each other through difficulties. I bring to you today all the needs of my family [mention specific family intentions]. Help us to love each other with patience and kindness, especially when we disagree or when stress makes us irritable with those we love most. Where there has been hurt or misunderstanding in our family, bring healing and reconciliation. Help family members who are struggling with health problems, financial difficulties, relationship issues, or spiritual challenges. Guide our children as they grow and make important decisions about their futures. Give parents wisdom in raising their children and help children to respect and appreciate their parents. Protect our family from the forces that would divide us and help us to stay connected even when physical distance separates us. Bless extended family members and help us to maintain good relationships with relatives. If any family member has wandered from the faith, draw them back with your gentle love. Help our family to be a source of strength and support for each other and a witness to God's love in our community. O Mother of Perpetual Help, bless our family. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help's experience in the Holy Family gives her special insight into family needs and challenges. Her prayers can help heal divisions, strengthen bonds, and bring God's peace into family relationships.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, watch over my family and help us to love and support each other as the Holy Family did.
days.scripture: "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord." - Joshua 24:15

days.title: Day 8: Perseverance in Faith
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, your faith remained strong throughout your life, even when you couldn't understand God's plans or when circumstances were difficult. From the moment of the Annunciation through the crucifixion and beyond, you trusted in God's goodness and wisdom. Help me to persevere in my faith when it seems easier to give up or turn away from God. Sometimes my faith feels weak, especially when prayers seem unanswered or when I see suffering in the world that I cannot understand. When doubt creeps into my mind or when I'm tempted to think that God doesn't care about my struggles, strengthen my faith as you strengthened your own through constant prayer and reflection on God's word. Help me to continue practicing my faith even when I don't 'feel' particularly religious or when spiritual exercises seem dry or meaningless. Remind me that faith is not primarily about feelings but about commitment and trust. When others mock or challenge my beliefs, give me the courage to remain faithful while also being respectful and charitable toward those who see things differently. Help me to grow in understanding of my faith through study, prayer, and participation in the life of the Church. O Mother of Perpetual Help, keep my faith strong. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our Lady of Perpetual Help's perseverance in faith, even through the darkest moments, provides us with a model for remaining faithful when our own faith is tested. Her prayers can strengthen our commitment when we feel weak.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, help me to persevere in faith through all circumstances, trusting in God's love even when I cannot understand His ways.
days.scripture: "Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful." - Hebrews 10:23

days.title: Day 9: Gratitude and Trust
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Perpetual Help, as I conclude this novena, I want to thank you for all the ways you have already helped me, even when I wasn't aware of your intercession. Your perpetual help has been at work in my life from the moment I was born, protecting me from dangers I never knew existed and guiding me toward good even when I was making poor choices. Help me to develop a spirit of gratitude that recognizes your constant care and God's many blessings in my life. When future difficulties arise, help me to remember this novena and to turn to you immediately with confidence in your willingness to help. Teach me to trust not only in your perpetual help but also in God's perfect timing and wisdom. Sometimes the help we receive is different from what we expected, but it is always exactly what we need for our spiritual good. Help me to be patient when prayers seem unanswered and to trust that you are working behind the scenes for my benefit. I promise to honor you always as my Mother of Perpetual Help and to encourage others to turn to you in their needs. May this devotion continue to grow in my heart and bear fruit in my daily life through greater trust, more consistent prayer, and deeper love for you and your Son. O Mother of Perpetual Help, I trust in your constant care. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, pray for us.
days.reflection: Our gratitude to Our Lady of Perpetual Help should be based not only on specific favors received but on her constant, ongoing care that we may not always recognize. This trust in her perpetual help can give us peace in all circumstances.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of Perpetual Help, I thank you for your constant care and trust in your ongoing intercession for all my needs.
days.scripture: "Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus." - 1 Thessalonians 5:18

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Help
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time, but many people pray it on Tuesdays (traditionally associated with Our Lady of Perpetual Help) or in preparation for her feast day on June 27. The devotion emphasizes Mary's constant availability to help her children in all their needs, both spiritual and temporal. Many churches hold special devotions to Our Lady of Perpetual Help on Tuesday evenings, and the famous icon continues to be venerated worldwide for its miraculous intercessions.
